name: Toedscruel

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavor:
It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out
their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds
along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.
